October 2025. The Granite 4.0 models were trained on sequences up to 512K

128K tokens.

Granite 4.0 Nano — the smallest variants, at 350M and roughly 1.5B
parameters — followed shortly after the initial October 2025 release,
aimed at running locally, including in-browser.
